The '''Corellian Engineering Corporation Space Dock''' was a space dock model used at the [[Tallaani Shipyards]].

==History==
The Tallaani Shipyards had hundreds of dry docks servicing warships and freighters.
Most of the space docks were over 200 years old by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and routinely underwent updates and ravamping procedures to keep them up-to-date with technological and security developments.<ref name="LOTE" />
